name: Aldoro Resources Limited
summary: Aldoro Resources Limited, a junior exploration company, engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Australia. It primarily explores for nickel, gold, and copper deposits. The company's flagship project is the Penny South project located in the the Youanmi Gold District, Murchison Region of Western Australia. Aldoro Resources Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
